transcript.text: Mara, before you approve the audience-vote operating package, I need to flag critical broadcast compliance constraints I discovered this morning. Importantly, the legal rider containing these requirements has not yet been attached to the production packet, so these constraints may not be visible to anyone else reviewing the package.
